title: To keep growing, incoming Best Buy CEO says he first wants to go smaller
summary: Incoming CEO Jason Bonfig is poised to lead Best Buy with a vision that emphasizes both expansion and a refined customer experience. He has articulated his intent to focus on smaller store formats as a strategic move to enhance the company's reach. This approach aims to adapt to changing consumer preferences while maintaining operational efficiency. Bonfig's leadership marks a pivotal moment for Best Buy as it navigates the competitive retail landscape.
